items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Like what we admire about Frank Sinatra, Frank Sinatra can sing a tune -- and sing it as the notes are written.

ctx.x: Jay can sing in that same nasal way.

Yeah, he can sing in a nasal way, but you can hear him singing the tunes and the melodies, you know. Like what we admire about Frank Sinatra, Frank Sinatra can sing a tune -- and sing it as the notes are written.
